observations.humor_and_voices: Neet wants to carry India home through absurd possessions and snacks; Buddy wants his irreplaceable bowl and blanket intact. The moving-bowl/Yes exchange gives Buddy an active understated joke. Heather’s poster reply follows the prop falling instead of generic scolding. Neet’s grandiosity and Buddy’s dry practicality remain distinct.
observations.emotional_space: Chirag’s until-next-time and Neet’s silence have room before the airport reset; no picture or added punchline breaks that goodbye. The final parallel keepsakes earns warmth without a speech.
observations.cause_effect: The packing shell becomes the security dust. Buddy’s protective bowl choice continues through repeated checks and, in the primary, an actual rescue from dal. The empty bowl then motivates his own temptation after the secret masala reveal.
observations.payoff: Buddy briefly considers undoing his own preservation rule. Heather’s Not in there follows the picture and lands cleanly; his look-away response and the two possessions carried home close both comic and emotional arcs.
observations.complementarity: Packing is an object-rich domestic standoff, airport is a wide public accident with simultaneous human and dog reactions, arrival is a quiet curbside temptation. Three states advance setup, complication and payoff rather than repeating portraits.
observations.variant: The complete omit-lounge reading is coherent: the sneeze conclusion leads into the long flight without a dangling dal reference. All three images belong to shared scenes; no primary-only lounge image intrudes. Removing the rescue reduces one Buddy action but retains bowl-blocking, airport protection and final temptation.
observations.presentation: Readable text and intact image anchors at 1280x720. Large images provide deliberate pauses without splitting dialogue attribution. All images loaded. Provenance remained readable through the final reader-49 pin.
